Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 완수한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 식사 후 다시 훈련을 하러 갔다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After finishing the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ate and then went straight back to training.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼をやり遂げた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、食事の後、再度トレーニングに向かった。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>吃完饭后又去训练了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>吃完飯後又去訓練了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir terminé la mission, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a mangé et est retourné s'entraîner.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> den Auftrag erledigt hatte, ging er/sie nach dem Essen wieder zum Training.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de completar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> comió y luego regresó a entrenar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após concluir a missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> comeu e voltou direto para o treinamento.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ทำภารกิจสำเร็จแล้ว ได้กลับไปฝึกฝนต่อหลังจากรับประทานอาหาร
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah menyelesaikan misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> makan lalu kembali berlatih.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã hoàn thành nhiệm vụ, sau khi ăn xong, liền quay lại luyện tập.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मिशन पूरा करने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने भोजन किया और फिर प्रशिक्षण के लिए वापस चला गया।
